div.head: IV Eg 10
div.ab: Gif he þonne cenð, þæt he hit mid gewitnysse bohte þara manna, þe to gewitnesse genamode synt, aðer oððe on byrig oððe on hundrode, ⁊ se hundredes ealdor þæt geácsoð, þæt hit soð is, þolige þeah þæs orfes, for þy þe he hit his neahgeburum cyþan nolde ne his hundrodes ealdre, ⁊ næbbe his na maran hearm.

Gif he ðonne cenð, þæt he hit mid gewitnysse bohte þara manna, þe to gewitnysse genamode synt, aðer oððe on byrig oððe on hundrode, ⁊ se hundrodest ealdor þæt geacsoð, þæt hit soð is, þolige þeah þæs orfes, for ði þe he hit his neahgeburum cyðan nolde ne his hundrodes ealdre, ⁊ næbbe his na maran hearm.

Si autem unum aut duos aut (eo) amplius ex triginta sex uiris sibi in testimonium assumpserit, et principes hundred ita se rem, ut prosecutus est, habere cognouerit, ratione qua supra protulimus, nullum quodlibet aliud nisi armenti sui dampnum patiatur et incurrat, eo quod uicinorum notitie hoc idem aperire et confiteri recusauit.

Gif he ðonne cenð þæt he hit mid gewitnysse bohte þara manna þe to gewitnysse genamode synt, aðer oððe on byrig oððe on hundrode, ⁊ se hundrodes ealdor þæt geacsoð þæt hit soð is, þolige þeah þæs orfes, for ði þe he hit his neahgeburum cyðan nolde ne his hundrodes ealdre, ⁊ næbbe his na maran hearm.

Wenn er nun erklärt, dass er es gekauft habe mit Zeugniss jener Männer, welche zur Zeugenschaft ernannt sind, entweder in der Stadt oder in der Hundertschaft, und der Hundertvorsteher es erkundet, dass dies wahr sei, verliere [zwar Käuf]er jenes Vieh dennoch, weil er es seinen Nachbarn oder seinem Hundertschaftsvorsteher zu melden unterlassen hat, trage jedoch keinen weiteren Nachtheil davon.

If he then declares that he bought it with the witness of those men who are appointed as witnesses, either in the borough or in the hundred, and the head of the hundred finds out that this is true, let [the buyer] nevertheless lose the cattle, because he would not report it to his neighbours or to the head of his hundred, but let him suffer no further harm from it.

If, however, he makes it known that he has bought it with the cognisance of the men who have been nominated as witnesses, either in a borough or in a hundred, and the head of the hundred learns that his statement is true, he shall none the less forfeit the livestock, because he has failed to give notice of it to his neighbours or to the head of his hundred, but he shall suffer no greater loss.

If then he declares that he bought it with the witness of the men who are nominated as witnesses, either in a borough or in a hundred, and the man in charge of the hundred discovers that it is true, he is nevertheless to forfeit the cattle, because he would not announce it to his neighbours nor to the man in charge of his hundred; and he is to suffer no more loss in this matter.

note.seg: Die Versio setzt aus 6, 2 die Zahl, jedoch ändernd ein, die sie dort ausliess. Sie vergisst, dass doch nicht für jedes Gericht der Ausschuss 36 Mann umfasste, laut o. 5
The Versio inserts here, though altered, the number from 6, 2 which it omitted there. It forgets that the committee did not, after all, comprise 36 men for every court, as above 5
Der Ort des Kaufens, nicht der Ernennung, ist gemeint.—Hundred = offenes Land
The place of purchase, not of appointment, is meant.—Hundred = open country
Versio verweist für den Grund auf 8, 1 zurück und wiederholt ihn dann, wie Eg, dennoch
The Versio refers back to 8, 1 for the reason, and then, like Eg, nevertheless repeats it
Liebermann takes this to mean ‘in the open country.’
næbbe his etc. Liebermann translates his by ‘davon.’ The meaning is not clear to me.
